question: Should OpenClaw ship third-party Android `Always` background location under this privacy model after the foreground-service prerequisite bug is fixed?
rationale: The prior implementation was explicitly closed pending product/security approval, and this patch broadens sensitive background location access beyond an ordinary Android bug fix.

options.title: Approve With Gating And Proof
options.body: Keep the feature direction, require the location-service foreground-service gate fix, and require redacted real-device proof before treating the behavior as release-ready.

options.title: Hold Or Revert Until Security Review
options.body: Pause the feature or revert the merged change until the privacy copy, notification behavior, flavor policy, and proof bar are explicitly approved.

options.title: Narrow To Foreground-Only
options.body: Reject Android background location for now and leave the canonical docs/issues describing foreground-only behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve With Gating And Proof
recommendation.body: Keep the feature direction, require the location-service foreground-service gate fix, and require redacted real-device proof before treating the behavior as release-ready.

likelyOwner.reason: obviyus was requested for review on this PR and is tied by history to the Android background-location policy boundary.
